seo.title: Get a Free Quote — uPVC Windows & Doors in Kathmandu
seo.description: Build your uPVC window, door, or panel quote in minutes. List your openings, sizes, glass, and colour, then send it to Hi-Tech on WhatsApp for a free, itemised quote in the Kathmandu valley.

hero.title: Build your quote in three short steps.
hero.body: List the windows, doors, or panels you need — rough sizes are fine. Send it on WhatsApp and we reply with a clear, itemised quote, usually the same day.

whatsappIntro: Hi Hi-Tech — I'd like a free quote.

points.title: We review your list
points.body: Our team checks openings, sizes, and glass, and replies on WhatsApp — usually the same day.

points.title: Free site measurement
points.body: In the Kathmandu valley we measure every opening on site, so rough sizes are completely fine.

points.title: Clear, itemised quote
points.body: You get a line-by-line price before any work begins. No obligation, no pressure.
